steps.headline: A small title, a soft lavender page, and room to read.
steps.changed: Removed the wallpaper, dark panels and oversized hero. The current website’s lowercase logo and lavender palette replace the older branding.
steps.notice: References: the live homepage’s logo, pastel palette and rounded navigation. The reading column stays unboxed; all legal wording and the September 15, 2026 date are unchanged.
steps.risk: Local preview only. The branch homepage is unchanged; no newer commits were merged.

steps.headline: The terms get the same quiet layout and an always-available section index.
steps.changed: Small rounded headings, restrained dividers and a plain reading column replace the heavy cards. The index remains beside the text as you scroll.
steps.notice: All 17 sections and the September 3, 2026 effective date are preserved. The original Markdown remains the legal source.
steps.risk: About still opens GitHub. Its links will change only after you approve the pages.

steps.headline: On phones, the pages stay simple and the index folds away.
steps.changed: The compact title brings the policy closer to the top. Both policies use the same light layout and an expandable section index.
steps.notice: Open “On this page” to jump to any section. Both pages work without JavaScript, including the policy switch and section links.
steps.risk: The documents remain long; no legal copy has been shortened.
